talking_points: SoftBank posted a $7bn quarterly loss after burning billions securing power equipment for its US AI data centres, even as its OpenAI stake soared in paper value.
TSMC's October sales jumped nearly 60% as Nvidia and Apple orders keep the chip boom running, while the Bank of England's governor warned the same AI rally could still turn into a bubble.

A wall of data-centre debt is approaching its refinancing date just as hardware-testing startup Nominal and modular-builder Mavria show investors are still happy to write fresh cheques for AI infrastructure.
